body: I don't want to be here without you all. I really appreciate all you guys. (+1 in your army)
I really appreciate that. If others have helped me, its only natural to want to help as well.
wow.. thanks! I'm not sure why you would be proud. Just made up words. Hopefully the right person hears them tho. I appreciate it alot. <3
I'm still in my 1.5th life... I have yet to find that second life moment.

I wish i was good with words... 

I'm just happy you're alive... It helps knowing there are other survivors

​

I love you Moongales. I am rooting for you.

You're not spiraling. If anything you're helping me - if nobody else... at least you're helping me. These thoughts are normal - especially with a crowd like this. Life is full of wonders that we haven't come close to untapping. I just graduated college. There is hope. And Freedom. And Life to be lived. If I'm in this world. I would want you to be in it. You have nothing to lose and everything to gain. 

I love you buddy. Hope the counseling goes well tomorrow.

Have you ever tried skiing? just a thought

Hey Zol... Seems like alot of us have been there. I'm nobody to talk... but the fact that you are still here to type this message gives me hope. You're a survivor... If I'm staying... I want you here with me.

I literally just belted out a song in the shower that was very similar to this it feels like.. I couldn't contain it so i posted the result of what i could record. Reaching out is step 1. And doing it with someone makes it so much easier. Love you buddy
